title: Ask about an English course
prompt: You are interested in joining an English course at a local learning centre. Write a letter to the course coordinator.
points: Explain why you want to join the course.
Describe the English skills you want to improve.
Ask about the timetable and course fees.

title: A damaged delivery
prompt: You ordered a desk lamp online, but it arrived damaged. Write a letter to the retailer's customer service team.
points: Give details of your order.
Describe the damage and explain how it affects your use of the lamp.
Say what you would like the retailer to do.

title: Invite a friend to a festival
prompt: A festival is taking place in your town next month. Write a letter to a friend inviting them to visit.
points: Describe the festival.
Explain why you think your friend would enjoy it.
Suggest when to arrive and where to stay.

title: Request a shift change
prompt: You need to change one of your work shifts next week. Write a letter to your manager.
points: Say which shift you need to change and why.
Suggest another shift you could work.
Explain how you will make sure your duties are covered.

title: Thank a former teacher
prompt: You have achieved a goal that one of your former teachers helped you work towards. Write a letter to the teacher.
points: Tell the teacher what you have achieved.
Explain how their support helped you.
Describe what you plan to do next.

title: Report a problem in your flat
prompt: A window in your rented flat no longer closes properly. Write a letter to your landlord.
points: Describe the problem and say when it started.
Explain how it is affecting you.
Ask for a repair and suggest a suitable time for someone to visit.

title: Return a borrowed bicycle
prompt: You borrowed a bicycle from a friend and cannot return it on the day you agreed. Write a letter to your friend.
points: Apologise and explain why you cannot return the bicycle on time.
Suggest a new time and place to return it.
Ask whether your friend needs it sooner.

title: Lost property on a train
prompt: You left a bag on a train during a recent journey. Write a letter to the railway company's lost property office.
points: Give details of the journey.
Describe the bag and its contents.
Explain how the office can contact you if the bag is found.

title: Suggest improvements to a community centre
prompt: You regularly use a community centre and have ideas about how it could better serve local residents. Write a letter to the centre manager.
points: Explain how you currently use the centre.
Describe the improvements you would like to see.
Explain who would benefit and why.

title: Help a friend prepare for a visit
prompt: A friend is planning to visit your area for the first time and has asked for advice. Write a letter to your friend.
points: Recommend a good time of year to visit.
Suggest two things to see or do.
Explain how to get around the area.
